contract.scope: _noise only; harmonic synthesis unchanged; no MOS

criteria.silence: exact zero where interpolated target power is zero
criteria.empirical_power: descriptive only; eight seeds do not guarantee convergence, especially narrow bands

limitations: Synthetic noise-only control measurement, not human quality or MOS calibration.
Finite eight-seed power variation is reported, not thresholded.
Pitch noise invariance is appropriate: independent noise PSD remains fixed under pitch edit.
Time edits verify exact output length and absence of nonfinite samples; do not imply identical stochastic waveforms.
